I was told that it was my fault for not updating my address with the hospital as it was a separate system and that I would have to ring at 8am to make another doctors appointment. I was never previously told that I had to also update my address with the hospital and reasonably expected that once I had updated my address with the doctors surgery that it would be updated across the other systems. doesn’t even matter that the majority of doctors and nurses are decent because the receptionists and clinic itself is awful.
I was waiting in a 40 minute phone queue (had to call over 200x) just to speak to someone, then even with an email from an A&E doctor stating I had to be seen that day they instead suggested going elsewhere or waiting 2 weeks!! The amount of times this practice try and pass you off to avoid doing their actual job is ridiculous, they don’t care about your welfare in the slightest
This isn’t even my first bad experience, they have waiting lists 10x the usual for the coil(the suggested 10 months is comical especially as after recently giving birth I was supposed to be a priority).
If you’re lucky enough to get an appointment you walk in to receptionists that instead of acknowledging your presence run to the other side of the office and turn their backs to you (if you’re busy doing something you can easily say that instead of being so rude).
When pregnant I’d have to fight to get appointments that were supposed to be scheduled and never even was seen for a 6 week check up (I tried to book and again was a horrible experience).
I haven’t met such unhelpful, unwilling and unwelcoming humans in my life and they’re supposed to be the face of this GPs? Every visit I’ve attended they've upset at least 2 people with how miserable and rude they are
The whole place is a joke which is such a shame as some of the doctors and midwives are lovely. It’s not short staffed if you don’t hire enough people, sort yourselves out

Edit:
As stated I’ve had some really bad experiences with this GP, however, the last few visits they’ve seemed to be improving. With a seemingly new receptionist who is extremely helpful and welcoming and shorter waits for the coil and appointments. It makes a massive difference and I really hope they keep it up.
